Student Score Analyzer (Modern C++)

Problem Statement:
You are given a list of students and their scores.
Your task is to analyze the data using modern C++ features and STL libraries.

🔹 Requirements

Write a program that:

Reads n student records.

Stores them using vector.

Uses unordered_map to compute average score per student (if repeated names appear).

Uses sort() with a lambda comparator to sort students:

Descending by average score

If tie → ascending alphabetical order

Prints:

Sorted student list with average scores

Top scorer

🔹 Input Format
n
name score
name score
...

Names may repeat.

🔹 Output Format
Sorted List:
<name> <average_score>
...
Top Scorer: <name>
